description: This file defines the MessageFormatter class within the GuzzleHttp namespace. It is responsible for formatting HTTP request and response messages into log-friendly strings based on customizable templates, supporting various placeholders for headers, bodies, timestamps, and other request/response properties.

classes.name: MessageFormatter
classes.description: A class for formatting HTTP messages into log strings using variable substitution templates. Implements the MessageFormatterInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MessageFormatter with a default or custom template string.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Produces a formatted log message string based on the provided request, response, and error objects, substituting placeholders with actual request/response data.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Helper method to convert message headers into a string representation for logging.
